description: -55℃~+155℃ 125mW 150V 3.9Ω Thick Film Resistor ±250ppm/℃ ±5% 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS
compatibility_notes: Added a missing generic 0805 3.9 ohm resistor ID. The FH series datasheet rates the package at 1/8 W and 150 V limiting element voltage and permits ±250 ppm/°C at ±5% from 1 ohm to below 10 ohms; JLC and same-code LCSC both list 125 mW, 150 V, ±5%, and ±250 ppm/°C. No matching generic ID or prior reviewed preference exists.
evidence_notes: Live JLC page at https://jlcpcb.com/partdetail/1656-RS05L3R9JT/C1304 confirms Extended class, FH, exact MPN, C1304, 0805, specs, stock 2933, available order quantity 2921, MOQ 1 and reel 5000. Same-code LCSC product page https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C1304.html confirms maker, MPN, code, package and ratings and links its C1304 datasheet. The JLC-linked PDF was downloaded through the browser; its first pages identify FH general thick-film chip resistors and the rating tables specify 0805 1/8 W and 150 V, -55 to +155 C, and ±200 or ±250 ppm/C for 1 ohm to below 10 ohms at ±5%.
